name: @tangram.gl/basemap-layers
description: Basemap layer and map-style helpers for deck.gl.

scripts.build: yarn build:types && yarn build:bundle && yarn build:worker
scripts.build:bundle: ocular-bundle src/index.ts --env=dev --format=esm --output=dist/index.js --externals=@loaders.gl/loader-utils,@loaders.gl/mvt,@mapbox/tiny-sdf,@maplibre/geojson-vt,@maplibre/maplibre-gl-style-spec,@turf/polygon-to-line,bidi-js,zod --sourcemap=true --sourcesContent=false && ocular-bundle src/map-style.ts --env=dev --format=esm --output=dist/map-style.js --externals=@loaders.gl/loader-utils,@loaders.gl/mvt,@mapbox/tiny-sdf,@maplibre/geojson-vt,@maplibre/maplibre-gl-style-spec,@turf/polygon-to-line,bidi-js,zod --sourcemap=true --sourcesContent=false && ocular-bundle src/index.ts --env=dev --format=cjs --output=dist/index.cjs --externals=@loaders.gl/loader-utils,@loaders.gl/mvt,@mapbox/tiny-sdf,@maplibre/geojson-vt,@maplibre/maplibre-gl-style-spec,@turf/polygon-to-line,bidi-js,zod --sourcemap=true --sourcesContent=false && ocular-bundle src/map-style.ts --env=dev --format=cjs --output=dist/map-style.cjs --externals=@loaders.gl/loader-utils,@loaders.gl/mvt,@mapbox/tiny-sdf,@maplibre/geojson-vt,@maplibre/maplibre-gl-style-spec,@turf/polygon-to-line,bidi-js,zod --sourcemap=true --sourcesContent=false
